svg.title: Where Each Rule Lives
svg.desc: Nested scopes: account instructions wrap every chat, Project instructions and knowledge wrap the chats in one Project, and skills plug in from the side only when a task calls for them; a client rule at account level leaks everywhere, and contradictory layers cause inconsistent output.
svg.text: Broader layers apply everywhere; skills join only when the task needs them.
Every chat: British spelling, answer first
Chats in this Project: naming rules, warnings format
for them, in any chat; need
